1b1('bum): @##//shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/glegs bam bzhi pa/bam po dang po/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/dran pa nye bar 
1b2('bum): gzhag pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar myi 
1b3('bum): dmyigs so//dran pa nye ba gzhag pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub semasad pa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyig so//dran pa nye bar gzhug pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/
1b4('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sngon kyi mthar myi dmyigs so//dra na pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa ni/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i phyir/
1b5('bum): gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyer/byang chub sems dpa'i phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/dran pa nye bar gzhag ba dben pa'i phyir/byang tshub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi 
2a1('bum): @##//dmigs so//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmigs so//dran pa nye par gzhag pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub kyi sems dpa' dbus su 
2a2('bum): myi dmigs so//dran pa nyi bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i dbus su myi dmigs so//dran pa nya bar gzhag pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems/dpa' dbus su myi dmigs so/dran pa 
2a3('bum): nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid/myed pa'i phyir/byang chub ses dpa' dbus su myi dmigs swo//de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i stong pa nyid dang /
2a4('bum): dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa dang /dran pa nye ba gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/dbus myi dmigs te/dran pa nye bar gzhag med pa yang gzhan ma yin/dran pa nye 
2a5('bum): bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid/yang gzhan ma yin/dran ba nye bar gzhag pa dben/dran pa nye bar gzhag ba ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi 
2a6('bum): mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin /dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwo ti'i bu/de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa med pa gang yin pa dang /dran pa nye par gzhag pa stong pa 
2b1('bum): nyid gang yin pa dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa gang yin pa dang /dran po nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang /dbus gang yin 
2b2('bum): pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/yang dag par spong ba myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' 
2b3('bum): sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs sos//yang dag par spong pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems/dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmigs so//yang dag par slong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub kyi sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs so//yang dgag par spong 
2b4('bum): ba myed pa'i phyir/byang chub/sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/yang dag par spong bstong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang cub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs so/yang dgag par spong ba dben pa'i phyir/byang cub sems dang /sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthur myi 
2b5('bum): dmyigs so//yang dag pa spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyor/byang chub sems dpa'i phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/yang dag par spong ba myed pa'i phyir/byang chu ba sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/
2b6('bum): byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myed dmyigs so//yang dag la par spong ba dben pa de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/yang dag par spong bar myed pa dang /yang dag par spong ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' de ci'i phyir 
3a1('bum): @#//dbus myi dmyigs te/yang dag par spong ba myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/yang dag par spong pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/yang dgapar spong ba dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ya nga dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin 
3a2('bum): byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin /dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/yang dag par spong bamyed pa gang yin pa dang /yang dag par spong bstong pa nyid 
3a3('bum): gang yin pa dang /yang dang par spong ba dben pa gang yin pa dang /'ang dag par spong ba ngo ba nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang 
3a4('bum): gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyig so//rdzu 
3a5('bum): 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sem dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi  dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrulagyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chubasems dpa' sngon gyi mtharamyi dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrulagi rkang pa myed pa'i phyir//byang chubasems dpa' phyi 
3a6('bum): mi mthar myi dmyigs so//rju 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong ba nyid kyi phyir/byang chubasems dpa'i phyi ma'i mthar myed dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrul:gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyi ra/byang chub sems dpa'i phyi ma'i mtharamyi dmyigs so//rdzu'aphrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myedapa'i 
3a7('bum): phyir/byang chub sems dpal phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//rje 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa' phyir/byang chubasems dba' dbus su myi dmyigs so//rdzu 'brul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyidakyi phyir/byang chubasems da ba' dbus su myi dmyigs sa//rdzu 'phrul 
3b1('bum): gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mying dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub semasadapa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa dang /rdzu 
3b2('bum): 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkangapa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang 
3b3('bum): pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/rdzu 'phral gyi rkang pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/rju 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bonyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yi na/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma 
3b4('bum): yin|dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwati'i bu/de ltar na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa med pa gang yin pa dang /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /rdzu'aphrul gyi rkang pa dben ba gang yin pa dang /rdzun 'phrul gyi rkang ba ngo bo nyid med pa 
3b5('bum): gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/dbang po med pa'i phyir 
3b6('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmigs so//dbang po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gi mthar myi dmyigs so//dbang po dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//dpang po ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/
3b7('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sngo gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/dbang po med pa'i phyir/byang chub semasapa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//de dbang po stong pa nyid kyi bar/byang chub sems dpa'-i phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/dbang po dben pa'i phyir 
4a1('bum): @#//byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi mas mthar myi dmigs so//dbang po myed pa'i phyir/byang chub kyi sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//dbang bo stong 
4a2('bum): pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dma' dbus su myi dmyigs so//dbang po dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems/dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs/dbang po ngo bo nyid myed ba'i phyir/byang chub sems de ci'i 
4a3('bum): phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa te'i bu/dbang po myed pa dang /dbang po stong pa nyid dang /dbang po dben pa dang /dbang po ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' mi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/dbang po med pa yang 
4a4('bum): gzhan ma yin/dbang po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/dbang po dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/dbang bo ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' 
4a5('bum): yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa shar/ti'i bu/de ltar na dbang po med pa gang yin pa dang /dbang po stongab nyid gang yin pa dang /dbangapo dben pa gang yin pa dang //dbang po ngo bo nyid med ba gang yin pa 
4a6('bum): dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/stobs med pa'i phyir/
4a7('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so//stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon kyi mthar mi dmyigs so/stobs dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs/stobs ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/
4b1('bum): byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//stobs myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//sto bas stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyig so//stobs dben pa'i phyir/byang chub 
4b2('bum): sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so//stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chubasems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar gyi dmyigs so//stobs med pa'i phyir/byang chub sem dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir//byang chub 
4b3('bum): sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyig so//stobs dpen pa'i phyir/byang chubasemasadapa' dbus su myi dmyigasaso//stobs ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir//byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so//de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/
4b4('bum): stobs med pa dang /stobs stong pa nyid dang /stobs dben pa dang /stobs ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/dbus mi dmyigs te/stobs med pa yang gzhan ma yin/stobs stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/
4b5('bum): stobs dben pa yang gzhan ma yin//stobs ngo bo nyid med ba yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin /dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa she ra dwa 
4b6('bum): ti'i bu/de ltar na stobs myed pa gang yin pa dang /stobs stong ba nyid gang yin pa dang /stobasadaben pa gang yin pa dang //stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang/byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' 
4b7('bum): gang yin pa dang /dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub kyi yan lag med pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so//byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa 
5a1('bum): @#//nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs swo//byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub semasad pa'i sngon 
5a2('bum): gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa'i phyir/byang chub kyi yan lag lag pa dpe yi phyir/byang chub sems dang 'phri ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//byang chub kyi yan lag 
5a3('bum): dben pa'i phyir/byang chung sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs swo//byang chub kyi yan lag ngo ba nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang che ba sems dpa' phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs so//byang 
5a4('bum): myi dmyigs so//byang chub gyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sesam dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//byang chu ba sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyig so//byang chub kyi yan 
5a5('bum): lag dben pa'i phyir/byangs chub sems dpa' dbus kyi mtha' myi dmyigs so//byang chub kyi yan lag/byang chub kyi yan 
5a6('bum): lag/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su/byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa'i phyir/bsam gtan gyi mtha' mi dmyigs so//
5b1('bum): chub kyi yan lag myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /byang  chub kyi yan lag dben pa gang yin pa dang //byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang/byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi 
5b2('bum): mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang /dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems 
5b3('bum): dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//'phags pa'i lam yan lagabargyad pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmigs so//'phags pa'i la ma yan lag brgyad pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub semasadapa' sngon gyi mthar myi
5b4('bum): dmyigs so//'phags pa'ilam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chubasems dpa' sngon gyi mtharamyi dmyigs so//'phags ba'i lam yan lag brgyad ba myed pa'i phyir/byang chub:sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/
5b5('bum): 'phags pa'i lam yan lag:brgyad pa stong pa nyidakyi phyir/byang chubasems dpa'i phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigasaso//'phags pa'i lam yang lag brgyad pa dben pa' phyir/byang chubasems dpa'o dbus su myi dmyigs so//'phagasapa'i lam yan lag brgyad 
5b6('bum): pa yan lag:brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dba' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmigs so//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyadapa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems pa'i dbus su myi dmyigs so/
6a1('bum): @#//byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa dang /'phags pa'i lam yan 
6a2('bum): lag brgyad pa dben pa dang /'phags pa'i la ma yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/'phags pa'i lam yan pag brgyad pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/'phags pa'i 
6a3('bum): lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/'phags ba'i lam yan lag brgyad ba dben pa yang gzhan ma yin//'phags pa'i lam yan lagabargyad pa ngo bo nyid myed ba yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi 
6a4('bum): mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwati'i bu/de ltar na 'phags pa'i lam yan lag:brgyad pa myed pa gang yin pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin

6b1('bum): 'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so//'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs swo//'phags pa'i bden pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub semsdpa' phyi ma'i mthar 
6b2('bum): myi dmyigs swo//'phags ba'i bden pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma' mthar myi dmyigs so//'phags ba'i bden pa myed pa'i phyir byang chub sams dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//'phagasapa'i bden pa stong pa nyidakyi phyir/byang chub 
6b3('bum): sems dpa' dbus su myi dmigs so//'phags pa'i bdan pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi  dmyigs so//'phags pa' bden pa ngo bo nyid myedapa'i phyir/byang chub sems

6b5('bum): pa'i bden pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/'phags pa'i bden pastong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/'phagasapa'i bden pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/'phags pa'i bden pa ngo ba nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yi na/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' 
6b6('bum): yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwati'i bu/de ltar na 'phags pa'i bden pa med pa gang yin pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /'phag sa pa'i 
6b7('bum): bden pa dben pa gang yin pa dang /'thags pa'i bden pa ngo bo nyad myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang/dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su 
7a1('bum): @#//myed de gnyis su byar myed do//tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/bsam gtan myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//bsam gtan stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs
7a2('bum): so|/bsam gtan dben pa'i phyir/byang chub semasadapa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmigs so//bsam gtan ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sams dpa' sngon gyi mthar myed dmyigs so//bsam gta na myed pa'i phyir/byang chu ba sems dpa' 
7a3('bum): phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/bsam gtan stong pa nyid gyi phyir/byang chub sems da ba' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs //bsam gtan dben pa' phyir/byang chub sems dang 'phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs 'o//bsam gtan ngo bo nyi de myed pa'i   
7a4('bum): phyir|byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmigs so/bsam gtan myed pa'i phyar/byang chub sems dpa'adabus su myi dmyigs so//bsam btan stong ba nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sams dba' dbus su myi dmyigs so/bsam ga tan   
7a5('bum): dben pa'i phyir/byang chu ba ses dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs //bsam ga tan ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyar/byang chubasems dpa' dbus su myi dmigs so//de ci'i phyir zhe na/tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu/bsam gtan myed pa dang /bsam gtan

16a6('bum): sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dris pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dba' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyig so//sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dre pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sem dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi domyigs so//sangs rgyas kyi
